findings.finding: Acceptance 1's 'smallest value the daemon accepts' is worker_stop_timeout_seconds: 1 (config.go:439-456 refuses only <= 0); at 1 s the release cannot fit any drain (codegraphStopGrace 2 s, DefaultGrace 5 s), so only the refusal branch, or clamping the agent's grace, meets it.
findings.answer: The plan takes the refusal branch at configuration load; clamping is not adopted (it still would not fit at 1 s and shortens Oh My Pi's exit window).

findings.finding: The spec does not say where the refusal lives or which deployments it binds: worker_stop_timeout_seconds also drives tmux, whose shim gets no --stop-grace or --warm-codegraph; sandbox/tmux Options set the grace directly in tests (50 ms-1 s).
findings.answer: The refusal lives in config.Load under the existing runtime: kubernetes branch beside checkPodReachable; kubernetes-only; the Options structs and the shim's flag reader are not given the floor (the shim keeps its non-positive refusal) and the reasons are recorded.

findings.finding: The spec names no floor and no invariant; a floor below ~2 s does not prevent the lease being left, and a floor F implies a minimum stop grace of 6 s + F; warmUpDrain's comment promises 'waits not at all' for a grace that leaves nothing.
findings.answer: MinWarmUpDrain = 3 s (codegraphStopGrace 2 s + 1 s for reap and release), MinStopGrace = 9 s; the invariant is Grace + drainTimeout + drain <= stopGrace from MinStopGrace up, refused below; the comment is rewritten. The tighter (2 s, 8 s) pair is recorded for the architect.

findings.finding: Neither 'the daemon's log' nor 'the pod watch' can carry the success line today: the warm-up writes to stderr (the role container's log), shimwire has no log frame, the daemon reads a container's log only when it has failed, and the pod watch records pod objects.
findings.answer: The line goes to the role container's log (pods/log) and stage 4b reads it with kubectl logs --all-containers --timestamps --prefix under its admin context (it already runs op logs). Recorded as spec departure 1; a wire frame is not added.

findings.finding: 'Elapsed time from launch' has three readings (pod creation, process start, agent's first frame) and warmCodegraphIndex holds no launch instant.
findings.answer: Launch is the shim's Run start (the role container's launcher starting this generation); WarmCodegraph and WarmCodegraphIndex gain a launched time.Time; the line carries the build's duration and the time since launch; stage 4b measures pod creation to the line's kubelet timestamp itself.

findings.finding: A line logged only on a finished build leaves nothing to read when the index is already complete, on the second index attempt, or in the five containers that did not win the lease; the checkpoint reads the planner's container only.
findings.answer: The line is logged only on a build exiting 0 (no noise on relaunch); the checkpoint reads every container of tree 2's pod and runs at the pod's first launch, where one shim builds; it fails when no container logged one.

findings.finding: warmLeaseHeartbeat is a 10 s const with no seam; the warmLeaseStep hook fires in acquireWarmLease, not in the ticker.
findings.answer: holdWarmLease gains the interval as a parameter (acquireWarmLease passes warmLeaseHeartbeat; the test passes 10 ms) and the tick is extracted as refreshWarmLease(path, token) bool, table-tested directly as well.

findings.finding: drainWarmUp waits on real time.After; with a floor the bound-zero test either sleeps the floor or tests nothing.
findings.answer: drainWarmUp moves to s.clock.After; TestTheWaitForTheWarmUpIsBoundedByTheStopGrace becomes the floored wait driven by the fake clock (clock.next(t, MinWarmUpDrain).elapse()).

findings.finding: Acceptance 3's command list omits ./internal/shim/... (where drain_test.go lives); bunx biome check covers neither Go nor the stage script; the e2e lib's bun tests are named nowhere.
findings.answer: The plan's checks add ./internal/shim/... and ./internal/config/..., bun test scripts/e2e/lib and bash -n on the stage script. Recorded as spec departure 2.

findings.finding: 'Fails against a deliberately wrong bound' names no runnable mutation; 'the drain bound' is both the returned value and the invariant.
findings.answer: Two named mutations through go test -overlay (drop '- drainTimeout'; floor 0), each failing a named invariant, their output quoted in the handoff; the test asserts both the values and the invariants.

findings.finding: The spec's fourth bullet (the success line and stage 4b's read) has no acceptance criterion.
findings.answer: The plan adds criterion 4: the line's exact shape, a unit test that it is logged once on success and not on an already-complete index or a failed build, and the stage 4b checkpoint with its bun-tested parser. Recorded as spec departure 3.

findings.finding: 'The docs say which' names no documents; four places state the current behaviour.
findings.answer: docs/kubernetes.md's warm-up paragraph, root AGENTS.md:61, the troubleshooting table (one row for the refusal) and the LEGION-629 solution note's 'Known edge' bullet are each named in the plan.

findings.finding: The spec does not say what a holder does once its lease was taken over: skip the refresh, stop the ticker, or end the build.
findings.answer: The heartbeat stops ticking on a foreign token or a missing lease; the build is left running (ending it is new behaviour outside 'guard it'); recorded for the architect.

findings.finding: A deadline-based drain has no instant on the path where the agent exits by itself (no terminate ever happened).
findings.answer: The drain stays a duration with a floor; the deadline alternative is rejected for that reason in the plan.

findings.finding: The pod's terminationGracePeriodSeconds is math.Ceil of the duration while the shim gets the exact value, so sub-second graces disagree.
findings.answer: The configured key is whole seconds and both are >= 9 after the refusal; noted in the plan.

findings.finding: Two spec references do not resolve: docs/kubernetes.md 'around lines 859-863' (the paragraph is at 1615-1632) and packages/daemon/AGENTS.md (does not exist).
findings.answer: The plan names the paragraph by its text at its current lines and says the root AGENTS.md is the daemon's guide.

findings.finding: Three statements are unverified from the tree: the review's text (quoted from gh api), the Stage 4b gap claim, and the LEGION-629 timing figures (prose in a solution note).
findings.answer: The review text was read with gh api and quoted in the context; the timing figures are cited as LEGION-629's measurements and the floor keeps a 1 s margin over the hard 2 s kill; the implementer's drives re-measure the stop and record the figures.

specDepartures.spec: Log one success line with the elapsed time from launch, on a surface stage 4b can read (the daemon's log or the pod watch), and have stage 4b's checkpoint read it.
specDepartures.plan: The success line goes to the process's stderr, which in a pod is the role container's log (pods/log); stage 4b's repository-tools checkpoint reads it with kubectl logs --all-containers --timestamps --prefix under its admin context and computes the time from the pod's creationTimestamp to the line's kubelet timestamp.
specDepartures.evidence: packages/daemon/internal/workspace/codegraph.go:147-219 writes every warm-up line to os.Stderr; packages/daemon/internal/shimwire/frames.go:24-48 has no log frame, so the daemon's log would need a new shim-to-daemon frame (a pod-replacing change); the pod watch records pod objects; scripts/e2e/stage4b-sandbox-tree.sh:2971 already reads a pod's log with op logs.

outcome.scope: summary: the fourth bullet's surface is the role container's log read by kubectl logs, not the daemon's log or the pod watch

specDepartures.plan: The checks are go test ./internal/shim/... ./internal/workspace/... ./internal/config/... ./cmd/legion/..., bunx biome check ., bun test scripts/e2e/lib and bash -n scripts/e2e/stage4b-sandbox-tree.sh.
specDepartures.evidence: drain_test.go is packages/daemon/internal/shim/drain_test.go, outside the spec's list; the configuration refusal lives in packages/daemon/internal/config; the stage script's new parser has a bun test under scripts/e2e/lib as the existing stage4b-*.test.ts do.

outcome.scope: acceptance 3: the command list gains ./internal/shim/..., ./internal/config/..., bun test scripts/e2e/lib and bash -n on the stage script

specDepartures.spec: The spec's Acceptance lists three criteria; the fourth scope bullet (the success line and stage 4b's read) has none.

The live stage 4b run is LEGION-578's operator lane.
